h1: Custom Beer Mugs and Plastic Beer Cups with Your Logo
lead: Create branded plastic beer mugs, steins and pilsner cups for breweries, bars, festivals and promotional events. Choose the model and serving capacity below; we provide a free logo design proposal and product visual mockup.
html:
Compare Beer Mugs, Steins and Pilsner Cups

Choose a handled mug or stein for the grip format, or a pilsner-shaped cup for your serving presentation. The listed range includes PS, PP/PS, PC and Tritan models. Match the material and capacity to the actual product reference rather than transferring one model’s specifications to the whole category.

Place Your Brewery or Event Logo on the Cup

We screen print logos and patterns on plastic cups. Send the selected mug or cup, your artwork and required print colors. Our free design proposal and product mockup show the logo layout on that product before the production artwork is approved.

Plan the Complete Branded Order

Specify the model, quantity, logo colors, packaging, destination and arrival date. Product minimums are model-specific; logo-printing minimums also apply. For a cup shape outside the listed range, use the OEM/ODM workflow for design, tooling, samples and production.

Questions Before You Order

Do you supply plastic beer mugs as well as pilsner cups?

Yes. The displayed range includes handled plastic mugs and steins, pilsner-shaped cups and beer bat formats. Each model page identifies its material, capacity and specifications.

What beer-mug capacities can I compare?

Examples in the range include PJB-008 at 650 ml / 22 oz, PJB-009 at 350 ml / 12 oz and the PJB-003 pilsner style at 473 ml / 16 oz. Choose the model’s listed specification for your order.

Can you print a brewery or festival logo?

Yes. We screen print logos and patterns on plastic cups. Send your model and artwork for a free design proposal and visual mockup showing the logo on the selected product.

How do the product MOQ and logo-color MOQ work together?

The selected model has its own minimum order. Logo printing starts at 250 pieces for one color, 1,000 for two colors and 2,000 for three colors. The order must meet both the product and printing minimums.

Can you develop a beer cup that is not in the catalog?

Yes. Send your cup idea, target capacity, quantity and artwork. Our OEM/ODM workflow covers concept design, structure, tooling, sample approval and production.

What determines the bulk quotation?

The quotation covers the selected model, order quantity, decoration, packing and agreed delivery arrangement. Email niles@boomdrinkware.com with those details and your required arrival date.

Email Your Model or Idea for Free Design and a Quote
